user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop indexing box that advances an internal platform by one discrete step when rotated via an external hand crank, with the output remaining stationary between steps, all enclosed in a protective housing.
product_intent: A mechanical device that advances an internal platform by discrete steps through manual rotation of an external crank while maintaining stable positioning between steps within a protective housing.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop indexing box
The user should rotate an external hand crank to advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step
The output should remain stationary between indexing events
The mechanism should be enclosed inside a protective housing
The number of indexed positions is not prescribed
The product should be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, practical to manufacture, and suitable for repeated manual operation

requirements.statement: The product shall advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step when rotated via an external hand crank

verification.observable: platform advances one discrete step per crank rotation

requirements.statement: The product shall maintain stationary positioning of the output between indexing events

verification.observable: output remains stationary between indexing events

requirements.statement: The product shall enclose the mechanism inside a protective housing
The product shall operate through manual operation only
The product shall be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, practical to manufacture, and suitable for repeated manual operation

verification.reason: Verification of mechanical plausibility, ease of assembly, practicality of manufacturing, and suitability for repeated manual operation requires design evaluation not specified in request

freedoms.subject: number of indexed positions
freedoms.statement: The number of indexed positions is not prescribed

relations.rationale: The requirement for advancing the platform by discrete steps depends on maintaining stationary positioning between indexing events

operating_scenarios.name: Normal operation with indexing
operating_scenarios.description: User rotates hand crank to advance internal platform by one discrete step, then releases and the output remains stationary until next rotation

operating_scenarios.name: Housing protection
operating_scenarios.description: Mechanism is enclosed within protective housing during normal operation and maintenance
